scope: Selected LibreCAD_3 IMAGE move, rotate, component-wise scale and reflection geometry.
reproduction: rotate, scale and mirror returned null before the fix.
implementation: Use a shared geometry-copy helper that preserves identity, layer, metadata, block and display parameters. Transform insertion point and direction vectors with the existing coordinate operations. Mirror uses this project’s reflection about a 3D line; normalize a finite nonzero axis and refuse invalid axes.
validation: The new transform test fails before the fix because rotate returns null.
Nine focused image, elevated geometry, area and layer tests pass.
Checks include rotated and nonuniformly scaled 3D axes, planar scaling, shared 3D-line reflection, tiny and large finite mirror axes, zero/non-finite axis refusal, unchanged identity and metadata.
After zero/non-finite-axis refusals the same source image remains unchanged and a corrected mirror succeeds with the expected axes.
limits: No native rendering, import/export, undo/redo, 3D-plane reflection, arbitrary nonfinite input or general IMAGE semantics are qualified.
